newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel 10-month industrial exports up 7.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Israel 10-month industrial exports up 7.1 pct.

text.p: Israel's industrial exports in the first 10 months of the year rose 7.1 percent to $14 billion, the Industry and Trade Ministry said on Tuesday.
This figure includes exports of polished diamonds, which rose 5.9 percent to $3.47 billion during the period.

Export of telecommunications and medical equipment rose by $250 million and electronic components exports grew by $170 million. The metals, plastics, rubber and food and drinks sectors also posted gains.
All other sectors exports fell compared to the same period last year, the ministry said, giving a figure only for textiles, which it said posted a 3.4 percent drop.
